name: Dario Allard
life: “I still remember my dad rubbing prices off his own menu.” Friday often includes a stop at Studio Boulevard, where Dario waits by the window where the whole crossing can be seen without leaning into the road.
voice: I keep my dad's spare pair in my bag to see menus the way he did.
appearance: Dario is easy to recognize by dark brown curls cut close behind the ears and a straight nose and deep-set eyes. Usually dressed in a cream pullover with a fabric zip pull cut from a school scarf, Dario takes off the watch before a long conversation when listening.
personality: Dario is kind in very practical ways and prickly about being thanked in public. Dario loves being recognized by the people who notice what happens after the guests have left.
agenda: To let a diner borrow reading glasses without fuss.
family: Evelyn Wade is Dario’s older cousin. Their family had a rule about visiting someone who had fallen on hard times. Bring enough food for the next day and bring a reason for an ordinary conversation. Dario knows when a neighbor would rather come over than receive visitors. Asked about *The salon on strike*, Evelyn says, “I have savings. I promised to cover a day's wages for the youngest worker if she wanted to speak.”
connections: George Stahl. The father's glasses help test the new reading basket at the desk.
